newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Two Moscow policemen shot dead after vehicle check.
newsitem.headline: Two Moscow policemen shot dead after vehicle check.

text.p: Two policemen were shot dead and one was wounded in the east of the Russian capital on Tuesday when they tried to check documents of a car being driven without a number plate, police said.

A police spokesman said a police crew of three had stopped the unregistered Lada passenger car for identity checks. The passengers immediately opened fire with Makarov pistols, killing two policemen on the spot and wounding the third.
Gangland killings and organised crime have flourished in Russia since the collapse of the Soviet Union in 1991 and during the country's chaotic transition to a market economy.
